description: Syria. Prague. Washington D.C. Aurora. Every step pointed here. I grew up in Syria — where I learned to respect every religion and culture. I witnessed the Velvet Revolution in Prague in 1989. I came to America with nothing, worked at a gas station, earned a fellowship at the NIH, discovered a gene, and developed cancer treatments at the University of Colorado in Aurora. I traveled back to Syria to help thousands of refugee children get an education — risking my life to reach them. Then I came back to this district and ran a cancer clinic for 15 years. Fought for my patients one by one. Now the fight is for everyone.
title: Every Step Pointed Here | Dr. Witta for Congress | News
